caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered on the page, which appears to be a bottle or container with a conical top and cylindrical body. The bottle is rendered in tones of brown and ochre, with the upper, conical section in a lighter, yellowish-brown hue and the lower, cylindrical section in a darker, reddish-brown color. The word "Post" is written in large, black cursive letters across the top section of the bottle. The object casts a slight shadow, suggesting a light source from above. The drawing is framed by a simple double-line rectangular border, with ample empty beige or light tan space around the central object. There are some small spots and blemishes visible on the background, and the artist’s signature, "Chas. Coeau," is located in the bottom right corner of the inner border.
title: Bottle, Root Beer
